deploy-bot: Deploy initiated · env=devtest · ref=release/1.14.0 · commit=3f7a1c2 · triggered_by=maria

maria: kicking off smoke + preflight now. release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/1.14.0

jon: watching the latency dashboard and traces, ping me if anything >300ms p99

deploy-bot: Preflight smoke tests: 7/7 passed. Healthcheck=OK. Proceeding to canary -> 10% traffic.

lee: seeing p99 ~420ms on model-runtime-dev for a couple of slices (KV cache miss heavy) — digging in

jon: noted. if p99 > 300ms sustained for 5m we should pause and pin back to `release/1.13.2`

maria: agree. set hold criteria same as jon. tagging @jon for rollback if needed :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary scaled to 50% (commit=3f7a1c2). No errors reported by deploy bot.

lee: p99 is now spiking to ~480ms on a subset of requests correlated to cold KV keys. suspect batching change + quantization path.

maria: decision call — pause rollout. We will pin to previous stable and open rollback PR. Jon, please run rollback and post status here.

jon: starting rollback procedure now: `./tools/deploy rollback --env devtest --to release/1.13.2 --reason "p99 latency regression"`

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated · target=release/1.13.2 · initiated_by=jon · reason=p99 latency regression

infra-bot: autoscaling events normal, no infra errors during rollback window

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Post-rollback smoke: 7/7 passed. Deploy status: SUCCESS. Active tag pinned -> release/1.13.2

maria: thanks — created follow-up ticket ENG-9876 to capture telemetry + root cause. We'll discuss fixes (KV cache warming / batching revert) in next standup.

jon: logging rollback artifacts and timeline: https://redwood.internal/ops/rollback/1793456789

lee: will collect trace samples and push a small repro in the ticket. thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
